Veradermics has announced positive results from the Phase III trial of the VDPHL01 tablet for baldness.

Veradermics reported that the prolonged-release minoxidil tablet VDPHL01 met all primary and secondary endpoints in the Phase III study. The trial involved 536 men with mild to moderate androgenetic alopecia.
According to the company's data, differences from placebo in hair counts, patient assessments, and investigator evaluations were seen as early as two months. By six months, non-vellus hair growth per square centimeter was 28.6 with once-daily dosing and 36.4 with twice-daily dosing compared to 6.6 with placebo. The developers stated that no serious adverse events related to the drug or cardiac events were reported.

The company plans to submit an application for approval to the FDA. If approved, this would be the first non-hormonal oral treatment for androgenetic alopecia.

📌 Governance Snapshots: Why Your Tokens May Not Count in a DAO Vote

Main Points
⏺ Some DAOs calculate voting power using token balances from a specific blockchain block
⏺ Buying tokens after that snapshot may not increase your voting power
⏺ This post explains how balance snapshots work and why purchase timing matters

1️⃣ Core Idea — the protocol records balances at a selected block to determine how many votes each participant receives.
2️⃣ Why It Exists — a fixed reference point prevents voting power from changing every time tokens are transferred during the voting process.
3️⃣ Example — a vote uses balances from block #1000, but you buy tokens at block #1005. Those new tokens won't increase your voting power for that proposal.
4️⃣ Risk Surface — users may buy governance tokens specifically to participate, only to discover the snapshot already happened.
5️⃣ Practical Rule — before buying governance tokens, check the snapshot block, delegation conditions, and voting eligibility rules.

Final Thoughts

DAO governance isn't only about how many tokens you hold. It can also depend on when you held them. Sometimes your voting power is decided before the vote even begins.

450 Million Slips, One Verdict Pending 

Israel has printed 450 million ballot slips for 7,331,981 eligible voters. That is about 60 slips per voter. Only one of them counts.

Voting for the 26th Knesset began at 7 a.m. at 12,018 polling stations. Thirty-six lists are competing for 120 seats. 

Most stations close at 10 p.m., while stations in smaller communities, hospitals, prisons, and nursing homes close at 8 p.m.

Trains run free of charge on election day. Election monitors will carry some 15,000 cameras.

Tonight's exit polls will leave a large block of ballots unopened: an estimated 600,000–650,000 double-envelope ballots from soldiers and other voters casting ballots outside their assigned stations. 

Officials must first check for duplicate voting, then separate the outer envelopes, which identify the voter, from the sealed ballots.

Those ballots equal roughly 15 Knesset seats. Election-night celebrations will begin before they are counted.

👀 Justin Sun becomes PEPE’s largest individual holder, Arkham says 

🌐 Tron founder Justin Sun has accumulated nearly 3% of PEPE’s supply, with blockchain analytics firm Arkham Intelligence identifying approximately $51.25 million worth of the memecoin across his known and suspected wallets. According to an October 27 Arkham Intelligence report, the tokens entered Sun-linked wallets over the previous 10 days, making him the largest individual PEPE holder outside cryptocurrency exchanges.

🔗 The firm estimated his combined holdings at 2.82% of PEPE’s supply, although some wallets included in its calculations were attributed to Sun through blockchain analysis. At the time, PEPE had a market capitalization of approximately $1.81 billion, with exchanges controlling several of the largest known holdings.

📊 Binance held $337.5 million worth of PEPE, representing 18.7% of the supply, followed by Robinhood with $150.9 million, or 8.37%. Coinbase and OKX accounted for another 5.03% and 4.15%, respectively. Unlike Sun’s attributed holdings, exchange balances generally include assets held on behalf of customers, meaning their large positions do not necessarily represent investments made by the platforms themselves.

🚨 IS THE WORLD BEING PREPARED FOR A MAJOR INFRASTRUCTURE DISRUPTION?

Something very interesting is developing, and when you connect it to the cyberattack narrative we've been tracking for months, the timing deserves serious attention.

At least 13 countries now have government guidance encouraging citizens to prepare for emergencies by stockpiling food, water, medicine and other essential supplies.

These include Japan, the United Kingdom, Belgium, Germany, Sweden, Norway, France, the Netherlands, Ireland, Finland, Poland, Estonia and Denmark. Other countries have similar programs.

Not all 13 issued new warnings this month. Some have maintained preparedness programs for years. But several developments have occurred in a remarkably compressed period:

🇧🇪 OCTOBER 1 — BELGIUM: New national emergency-preparedness guidance published.

🇬🇧 OCTOBER 22 — UNITED KINGDOM: Government launches a nationwide campaign encouraging households to maintain approximately 72 hours of emergency supplies.

🇯🇵 OCTOBER 27 — JAPAN: Disaster minister announces an upcoming nationwide request for households to maintain at least three days of food, water and sanitation supplies, preferably seven days.

And that's only the civilian side.

🇺🇸 NOW LOOK AT WHAT THE PENTAGON IS DOING.

On September 30, Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth announced FORTRESS America, a sweeping initiative to make America's military installations capable of operating independently of vulnerable civilian infrastructure.

The initiative has five major pillars:

1. Independent power generation for military installations.
2. Domestic supply-chain independence.
3. Strategic reserves of fuel, ammunition, medicine and other essentials.
4. Protection against cyberattacks, sabotage and drones.
5. Resilient satellite communications and electromagnetic-spectrum capabilities.

On October 7, the Pentagon began formally establishing the FORTRESS America Program Office.

On October 20, senior defense officials confirmed that independent power generation was an immediate priority, including microgrids and backup energy systems.

And on October 25, additional reporting described plans for military installations to sustain operations for extended periods without outside support.

Think about the implications.

Governments are telling civilians to prepare for several days without normal services.

Meanwhile, the Pentagon is preparing military bases to function independently if the civilian electrical grid is compromised.

And all of this is occurring against the backdrop of an increasingly prominent international discussion about cyberattacks, infrastructure sabotage, supply-chain disruptions and communications failures.

NOW CONSIDER Q DROP 34.

Published November 1, 2017, Drop 34 described a hypothetical sequence involving civil unrest, temporary military control and the activation of an emergency broadcasting system to communicate directly with the American public.

The drop specifically referenced 11.3 and 11.4, although I wouldn't necessarily look at these as dates.

We've also been following Drop 4587, the recurring discussion surrounding 11.4, and what we believe may be narrative seeding and communications drawing attention to Cyber Attacks.

Will any of this become relevant?  Who knows?  Less than 10.....

But governments are discussing civilian emergency supplies while the Pentagon is openly preparing for scenarios in which the power grid, supply chains and communications infrastructure become unavailable.

IS THIS A WARNING?

We've spent months documenting the escalating cyberattack narrative. Now we're watching governments prepare populations and military installations for precisely the types of disruptions those cyberattacks could produce.

But it raises a question I think we should be asking:

Are we witnessing actual ordinary emergency preparedness — or a broader narrative seeding operation leading us to a planned "scare" event?

Only time will tell.....
